Bounded excerpts of actual BLS public responses captured 1 November 2026. The API fixture retains the original twenty codes and a recent monthly window; catalog.body retains the exact header and twenty matching catalog rows. Each HTML table retains its exact caption, headers, first seventy numeric rows, reviewed blank section row where present and original footnotes. candidate-source.json rebuilds those excerpts using the original full-response receipt hashes and actual retrieval timestamps; hashes identify the fetched originals, not the excerpts. The full original responses and complete candidate are retained under output/stitch-page-audit-2026-11-01/cpi/. Tests never substitute these excerpts for the canonical source capture.
